title: Northgate Store and Online Orders Price Match and Price Adjustment Terms
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders** refunds a lower price on an item already bought on the terms below. The terms are the same in every fulfilment program except for the list of competitors matched.

| Program | Calendar days after the order date within which a price drop or a match is refunded | Competitors whose prices are matched |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Store Purchase | 14 | Amazon.com, Walmart.com, BestBuy.com, HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com, a local competitor's ad |
| Northgate Order Pickup | 14 | Amazon.com, Walmart.com, BestBuy.com, HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com |
| Northgate Drive Up | 14 | Amazon.com, Walmart.com, BestBuy.com, HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com |
| Northgate Ship to Home | 14 | Amazon.com, Walmart.com, BestBuy.com, HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | 14 | Amazon.com, Walmart.com, BestBuy.com, HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | 14 | Amazon.com, Walmart.com, BestBuy.com, HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com |

**Terms common to every program.**
- Offers never matched or adjusted to: clearance, marketplace seller offers, membership-only prices, bundle offers, lightning deals and doorbuster events.
- Most price adjustments or matches per order line: 1.
- The competitor item must be identical (same brand, model, size and color) and in stock: yes.
- Refund basis of a price adjustment: the old net unit price less the new unit price, multiplied by the units still held, net of the cardholder discount where the Northgate Card paid (the unit difference times the units held).

**Hypothetical reading.** A local competitor's printed ad can be matched on a register purchase, but not on an order placed for pickup, shipping or delivery, whose list does not include it.
